svg.text: Blobly Net — the rest of the bus
each frame as the database says: cycle and event timing,
start values, multiplexing, CAN-FD, declared E2E;
from the project: UDS answers, NM where configured
Vector, CANsub — or a virtual bus
your test — Python, Lua or the GUI: set a signal, inject a fault,
expect what the ECU under test answers
TX-S the rest bus, RX what we did not send
